name: opencode-agent-guard
description: Runs the agent-guard command rules on every shell call: no polling, no blind long runs, no hidden errors, no wrong-shell syntax
about: Applies your own agent-guard command rules to every shell call, and installs the search-output helper that keeps large result sets readable. Without the external agent-guard package it loads only the helper.
needs: the agent-guard package on disk, at AGENT_GUARD_HOME or ~/Projects/agent-guard
